meta.description: Tourist, family visit and business visitor visas from Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune and Kochi. Official stay limits and fees for the UK, Canada, Australia and Schengen, US B1/B2 steps, and how Wayfarer prepares your file.

h1: A visit visa needs a clear purpose and proof you will come back.

facts.label: How to apply
facts.text: Complete the DS-160 online application, then book and attend your appointment at the US Embassy in New Delhi or a consulate, including Chennai. B1/B2 applicants appear in person for biometrics and the interview. Some applicants renewing the same visa class may qualify for an interview waiver.

facts.label: Stay and fee
facts.text: You can usually stay up to 6 months. The visa costs £135 for up to 6 months. You cannot do paid or unpaid work for a UK company.

facts.label: Stay
facts.text: Most visitors can stay for up to 6 months. The border officer decides the exact length when you arrive.

facts.label: Tourist stream
facts.text: For holidays and visiting family and friends. Stay of 3, 6 or up to 12 months. Costs from AUD 250 when applying outside Australia.

facts.label: Sponsored family stream
facts.text: For people sponsored, usually by a family member in Australia. Stay up to 12 months. Costs AUD 250.

facts.label: Business visitor stream
facts.text: For short business visits. Stay up to 3 months. Costs AUD 250. You cannot work or sell goods or services.

facts.label: Stay
facts.text: A short-stay Schengen visa allows visits of up to 90 days in any 180-day period, and is generally valid for every Schengen country.

facts.label: How to apply
facts.text: Apply at the consulate of the country you intend to visit, at least 15 days and no earlier than 6 months before your trip. The fee is €90 for adults, and the normal processing time is 15 days. You need travel medical insurance covering emergency care, hospital treatment and repatriation.

faq.q: Can I work on a visit visa?
faq.a: No. Visit visas do not allow you to work. Some allow limited business activities such as meetings.

faq.q: My B1/B2 visa was refused. Can I apply again?
faq.a: Yes. Understand why it was refused, change what you can, and apply again when your situation shows clearer ties to India. We help you prepare.
